## Summary
Describe the problem, implementation and user-facing effect.

## Change category
- [ ] UI or interaction
- [ ] Route or navigation
- [ ] Data model or fixtures
- [ ] Authentication or authorization
- [ ] Upload, preview, download or storage
- [ ] Security or privacy
- [ ] Tests or CI
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Dependencies or maintenance

## Validation
- [ ] `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Tested affected routes in a browser
- [ ] Checked keyboard and responsive behaviour

## Data flow and security boundary
Describe any new identity source, API, storage location, third-party processor or authorization rule. Do not claim a security property enforced only in the client.

## Privacy and safety
- [ ] No real documents, passwords, tokens or personal data added.
- [ ] Logs and fixtures do not expose sensitive values.

## Documentation
- [ ] Updated route/component/data documentation.
- [ ] Updated threat model/security review where relevant.
